resources.string: A separate network for visitors: they get internet, but can\'t see your devices or get into the router.
Turning it off keeps the name and password for the next visit.
The router\'s Wi-Fi is fully off (the radios, not just your network). Turn it on from LuCI to offer Wi-Fi to guests.
The router didn\'t get to broadcast the guest Wi-Fi, so it was left as it was.
The router didn\'t stop broadcasting the guest Wi-Fi, so it was left as it was.
Have your visitor point their phone camera at this code, or look for the network “%1$s” and type the password.
Your Wi-Fi restarts too: connected devices drop for a few seconds and rejoin on their own.
